# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)

# Load the cleanup stations tabular coordinates
cleanup_sites <- read_csv(here("data", "theme6_plastic_waste.csv"))
head(cleanup_sites)
```

# Tasks

1. Convert the tabular data to an `sf` spatial point object using coordinate reference WGS 84 (CRS 4326).
2. Reproject the spatial coordinates from unprojected WGS 84 to UTM Zone 37S (CRS 32737), standard for Tanzania.
3. Plot the reprojected cleanup points using `geom_sf()`, mapping the macroplastics count to size and color aesthetics.

Write your spatial vector mapping code below:

```{r}
# Convert to spatial object
cleanup_sites_sf <- st_as_sf(cleanup_sites, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Reproject to UTM 37S
cleanup_sites_utm <- st_transform(cleanup_sites_sf, crs = 32737)

# Plot UTM Projected map
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = cleanup_sites_utm, aes(size = macroplastics_count, color = macroplastics_count)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Plastic Waste Cleanup Locations (UTM 37S)",
    size = "Debris Count",
    color = "Debris Count"
  )
```
